summary: Second pass of the fuller enumeration (layer 3). Chapter 2 (Executive Office of the President) and chapter 3 (central personnel agencies) were read in full and every concrete, checkable recommendation was matched against the existing records. Thirteen further recommendations were researched, independently reviewed and scored blind for significance by two AI raters, with a third rater on three records where the first two differed: 12 from chapter 2 and 1 from chapter 3. No candidate was dropped in review as a duplicate; one chapter 2 candidate (revival of further first-term regulatory orders, page 49) was set aside before research as already within c02-07. Review changed five ratings: c02-14 from in progress to proposed, c02-15 from no action found to in progress, and lower progress scores for c02-16, c02-17 and c02-19. The new records are held off the page and out of the headline counts until the fuller enumeration is shown as a separate figure; they are included in the public data file. Stages as added: c02-09 not_started 0; c02-10 implemented 70; c02-11 implemented 65; c02-12 implemented 85; c02-13 not_started 0; c02-14 proposed 20; c02-15 in_progress 25; c02-16 in_progress 25; c02-17 in_progress 40; c02-18 implemented 65; c02-19 implemented 70; c02-20 proposed 15; c03-10 implemented 65. No key objective changed in this run.
title: Fuller enumeration: chapters 2 and 3
